verdict.rationale: CAM has a dedicated Legaltech & ALS page saying it was the first Indian firm to adopt AI/ML-based legaltech in day-to-day practice, with a quantified 20–30% efficiency gain from AI contract review. It also runs Prarambh, its own legaltech incubator, which beta-tests startup products, though nothing shows those products are AI-specific. This goes somewhat beyond a bare marketing mention, but the evidence names no specific AI tools and shows no published AI-use policy. Missing for 10: named AI tools or vendors used in client service, a published AI governance or usage policy, details of the Advanced Delivery offering's AI use, any first-party AI product, and independent corroboration.
